_comment: Final 256 px cell coordinates, measured on the title-style art (quantize-48 packed cells) by Claude 2026-10-11. Hit boxes sit on the striking limb's contact end (fist, palm, foot) padded about 3 px; smear streaks and arcs drawn ahead of or around the limb are left out, so a hit needs the drawn fist or foot to reach the body. Kept auto boxes: light1 f3 (forearm end + fist) and special f5 (the thrust palm). Chidori (special) f3-f4 hit with the leading head/shoulder (SPEC 'Strikes and contact zones'). _scale = the strip's auto-head fit these numbers were measured at (no re-scaling).
_hands: hand: palm/fingertip point (256 cell) for hand effects, shots and beams; measured by Claude 2026-10-11 on the title-style art from the packed frames: the Chidori lightning hand on every special frame (startup, run, thrust, impact, recovery), the Chidori Sharp Spear's open L palm (specialForward f0-f3; the spear leaves from f2), the raised Kirin palm (beamCharge) and the pointing palm (beamFire, the clash-stream origin). throw f1 is Sasuke's open mouth, the Great Fireball's release point (ANIMATIONS.md), with the raised R fingers just in front of it.

light1._note: f2: the lead fist (x 203-213); the auto box also took the navy smear streak drawn ahead of the fist (x 215-233). f3 keeps the auto box (forearm end + fist).

light2._note: the rear fist reaches only x 207-208 (3 px past the idle guard). f2 auto box took the smear streak ahead of the fist (to x 236); f3 auto box was the front 28% of the body down to the front foot.

light3._note: the kicking foot (sole forward, toes up) at x 236-249, y 98-128; the auto boxes covered the whole shin and the smear wisps (59x43, 58x47).

light4._note: the kicking foot at head height; f3's auto box covered the whole white crescent smear (x 196-253, y 71-185), f4's the shin and the guard fist.

heavy._note: v10: the R foot rising under the chin (f3) and overhead (f4). The v06-era f4 box [155, 10, 24, 42] sat in empty air 30 px behind the foot.

airLight1._note: the lead fist; the auto boxes ran from the sleeve (x 194) to the fist (61 and 56 px wide).

airLight2._note: the kicking R foot; the auto rising-strike rule put both boxes on the hair and the rear arm (x 47-131).

airLight3._note: the kicking heel; f2's auto box covered the white crescent smear (to x 253, down to y 192), f3's the whole lower leg.

airHeavy._note: the clasped fists; the auto boxes covered the navy smear arc above them (45x99, 41x87). boxPad [0.5, 0.45] still grows them a lot.

throw._note: v01 (old art). No melee box (projectile). f1 is the release frame: the fireball spawns at this point.

special._note: v13 with the auto-head fit x0.8711 and f6's -6 px offset, measured on the packed cells. The open R hand holds the lightning: beside the hip on f3, trailing back at chest height on f4. f3-f4 hit with the leading head/shoulder (f4: the head and the forward L fist); f5 keeps the auto box on the thrust palm (the old f5 box sat below it).

specialForward._note: v10 with the auto-head fit x0.8636. Projectile move (no melee): the boxes mark the open L palm; the spear spawns at the f2 hand. The palm is drawn upright, fingers up, not as a level spear-hand.

specialUp._note: v02: the R foot kicking straight up; the auto rising-strike rule put both boxes on the hair (the hit itself is checked by distance in kit.js).

beamCharge._note: the raised open R palm (Kirin call); the old points sat 55 px right of it in empty air.

beamFire._note: the pointing open R palm; the old points sat on the sleeve end 45 px behind it.
